title: Not right for me
text: Not right for me. Followed ALL INSTRUCTIONS DID NOT COOL AT ALL. Remote did not work put new battery in still did not work. Plus small leak. Couldn’t find where it was coming from.

product_metadata.title: IAGREEA 3-in-1 Evaporative Air Cooler, Portable Air Cooling Fan with 80° Wide Oscillation, 2 Ice Packs, Remote Control, 12H Timer Swamp Cooler for Room/Home/Office
features: More Than A Fan: Not only be a normal fan but also be an air cooling fan and humidifier. IAGREEA evaporative air cooler uses the natural cooling properties of water to quickly cool the air by absorbing dry, hot air and increasing the humidity of the air. Besides, adding ice boxes to the water tank can bring a surprisingly cooling feeling.

5 Modes For Choose & 3 Wind Speed: Powered by COOL/SUPER MAX/NATURAL/SLEEP/TIMER 5 modes and High/Middle/Low 3 wind speed, this bladeless evaporative air cooler generate a customize gentle breeze stream to cool down this hot summer day. Press the ‘SUPER MAX’ button for powerful cool.
160° Automatic Swing: Support both vertically and horizontally swing at 80 degrees. Select the wind angle through the remote control or the top operation panel to send coolness to every corner.

5.2L Removable Water Tank: Built-in 5.2L (1.37 Gallon) large water tank that can keep the evaporative cooling fan cooling for 10 hours. Humanized water shortage reminder, you don't need to pay attention to the remaining water in the water tank all the time.

23ft Remote Control: For the convenience of users, this small air cooling fan will come with remote control, you can easily operate this water cooling fan without any difficulties. Remote control range: within 23ft in front, within 16ft at 30° left and right.
